item.title: Finder Toolbox 0.2.2-beta.1
item.description:
• Drop targets: keep overlay visible with a progress indicator while the move/copy operation is in flight.
  • Drop targets: re-verify the target folder via Apple Events at drop time to catch stale cache entries.
  • Drop targets: avoid name collision when copying or moving into a folder that already contains a file with the same name.
  • Settings: probe Full Disk Access and Mail Automation status live on both the File Renaming and Drop Targets settings pages.
  • Settings: fix login-item toggle in debug builds and wrong-location installs; improve permissions probe reliability.
  • Internal: notch feedback component (groundwork, not yet surfaced in any UI).

item.title: Finder Toolbox 0.2.1-beta.1
item.description:
• Drop targets: replaced background polling with a one-shot cache that warms at start and refreshes at drag-end; panels appear immediately even on a cold cache, and stale labels for non-Finder sources update mid-drag.
  • Drop targets: hourglass loading state while a panel resolves; drops are refused until the target folder is known, so the move/copy decision can never be made against an unknown destination.
  • Drop targets: Spaces swipes mid-drag re-sync visible panels from the cache without an extra Apple Event round-trip.
  • Mail attachments: source URLs in another app's sandbox container now render the copy tint from the first paint instead of flipping move → copy on hover.
  • Permissions: dragging a file out of another app's sandbox container (Mail Downloads, etc.) without Full Disk Access now surfaces a proactive recovery dialog instead of a cryptic AppleScript / EPERM error.
  • Developer: new opt-in Developer settings page with a drop-target log viewer (filterable, copy/save) and a post-drop result toast — useful for diagnosing the "heard a copy sound but no file appeared" case.
  • Internal: silenced MainActor-isolation and Mail.app promise-drop deprecation warnings.

item.title: Finder Toolbox 0.2.0-beta.2
item.description:
• Drop targets: recover stuck overlays from missed drag-end events; show overlays immediately when the folder cache is cold and refresh mid-drag.
  • Drop targets: folder drops honor folder-mode + folder-rename-scope prefs, including recursive descent after the move/copy lands.
  • Undo: reverses drop-target moves and copies (not just renames); copies trashed via Finder so they sit in Finder's native undo stack.
  • Dev: Debug builds get a distinct bundle ID and "Finder Toolbox-Debug.app" name so Automation/FDA/UserDefaults are tracked separately from release.
  • Permissions: Finder Automation probe switched to AEDeterminePermissionToAutomateTarget (the old probe always reported Granted). Adds a "Request" button to ungranted entries.
  • Fix: dropping an item on its own Finder window no longer bumps the canonical name to "… 2".

item.title: Finder Toolbox 0.2.0-beta.1
item.description:
• New: Finder drop-target overlays with Mail / Safari / Photos promise support, modifier-driven move/copy semantics, and Space-change handling mid-drag (opt-in hover-gating available).
  • Renamer: folder-name rename scope (files-only by default) and recursive folder-mode handling.
  • Settings: dedicated permissions surface on the File Renaming page; Mail Automation grant surfaced; UI refresh.
  • Fixes: Sparkle auto-update toggle, debug-launch hotkey conflict, Mail conversation mode and SMB drop reliability.
  • Cleanup: quiet per-drag info logs so Console.app stays usable.
